name: @delfrance/functions
//runtime-deps: @delfrance/auth + @delfrance/core + @delfrance/data + @delfrance/schemas are BUILD-time only: esbuild bundles them into the deploy artifact (only firebase-admin/firebase-functions/@google-cloud/firestore/sharp stay `external`), so they live in devDependencies. The deploy does NOT upload this file — scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs emits a MINIMAL package.json (just the 4 `dependencies` below, no devDeps) into the generated .deploy/ folder, because the cloud `npm install` cannot resolve pnpm `workspace:*` (and the buildpack installs devDeps too). See apps/functions/DEPLOY.md. These 4 dependency specs must stay LITERAL semver — never catalog: — this dependencies block is copied verbatim into the artifact and resolved by plain npm. firebase-admin + firebase-functions are pinned EXACT (no `^`) because the artifact ships NO lockfile: a range lets the cloud install a version CI never tested, which is how firebase-functions@7.3.2 silently moved express 4→5 in a PATCH release. Bump them here and in pnpm-workspace.yaml's catalog in the same commit — packages/config-eslint/rules/runtime-deps-pinned.test.js fails if they drift apart.
